sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Pramod Kumar Sahu - advocate for the applicant.

Ms. Geeta Yadav- G.A appearing on behalf of respondent/
 ORDER

This is the second application filed by applicant Krishna Bihari @ Guddu for grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. relating to Crime No.295 of 2024 registered at Police Station Amarwara,
District - Chhindwara for the offence punishable under Sections 450, 376(1) and 506 of IPC.
2. Allegations against present applicant is that he entered into the house of prosecutrix and committed intercourse with prosecutrix against her will.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that on account of previous enmity applicant has falsely been implicated.
Charge-sheet has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail since 02.05.2024.
Earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file after two months vide order dated 08.07.2024 passed in M.C.R.C. No.21447/2024.
Hence, present applicant has been filed after two months.
No external or internal injury have been found on the person of the prosecutrix as well as applicant in their respective MLCs.
Prosecutrix is major lady.
There is nothing on record to show that at the time of incident applicant are with any weapon.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned Government Advocate for the State has opposed the bail application.
5. Having regard to overall evidence, including nature of evidence, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

7. It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
8.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial but in case of bail jump, breach of any of the pre-condition of bail and in case of repetition, this order shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
9. M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE R Krishna Bihari @ Guddu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157601583/
